evidence.detail: Art command downloads image without checking if preferred_printing was found; no guard for the case where the card was not in the requested set
scryfall_image() silently falls back to name-only URL (no set) when oracle.get_printing(c, preferred_printing) returns None
Flavor command correctly handles this: returns 'No flavor text for {c.preferred_printing}' when preferred_printing set but no matching printing found — the same pattern is needed in art.py

triage.fix_sketch: In discordbot/commands/art.py, after the 'if card is not None:' check, add: import oracle at top; then check 'if card.get("preferred_printing") and oracle.get_printing(card, card.get("preferred_printing")) is None: await ctx.send(f"{ctx.author.mention}: {card.name} was not in {card.get(\"preferred_printing\").upper()}."); return'. ~5 lines in art.py.
triage.notes: The functional test in discordbot/functional_test.py:52 tests flavor with a set pipe ('capital offense|UST') but there is no analogous test for art with a wrong set — a new unit test would be appropriate alongside the fix.
